items.title: Inkling
items.summary: Thinking Machines Lab launched its first in-house model called this week. The company openly acknowledges that Inkling is not the strongest overall model available today. Yet, it debuted as the leading American open-weights contender.

items.title: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
items.summary: Inkling debuted at 41 on the , making it the top U.S. open-weights model. It outscored Nvidia's Nemotron 3 Ultra (38) and Meta's Gemma 4 31B (29), which still being behind Chinese models such as GLM-5.2 and DeepSeek-v4 Pro.

items.title: Interaction Models
items.summary: Thinking Machines is not trying to build a static chatbot. They adhere to an " " framework, in which AIs are designed to natively interact with tools, environments, and multi-turn workflows.
